children: shares fell about 1.5% Thursday as the company and NASA made a new artificial-intelligence model available for public use, giving researchers another tool to work with lunar data.

The NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model was developed to process information collected from lunar observations. The system is trained on a broad dataset assembled by researchers from both organizations and is designed to help extract useful findings from complex scientific records.

The model uses information gathered through different instruments, which could make it easier for scientists to study the Moon's surface and other characteristics. The project also reflects an effort to apply AI to large collections of scientific data that can be difficult to analyze manually.

IBM and NASA said the technology is intended to support research tied to future lunar missions and scientific exploration. It could also contribute to longer-term efforts involving continued human activity on the Moon.
IBM's stock decline came as the new model moved into open-source use, allowing researchers to access the technology as they study lunar data and prepare for future exploration efforts.

title: IBM Stock Dips as New AI Model Targets Future Moon Missions
